datasets.title: Samoa: High Resolution Population Density Maps + Demographic Estimates
datasets.description: The world's most accurate population datasets. Seven maps/datasets for the distribution of various populations in Samoa: (1) Overall population density (2) Women (3) Men (4) Children (ages 0-5) (5) Youth (ages 15-24) (6) Elderly (ages 60+) (7) Women of reproductive age (ages 15-49).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/samoa-high-resolution-population-density-maps-demographic-estimates]
datasets.details: To reference this data, please use the following citation: Facebook Connectivity Lab and Center for International Earth Science Information Network - CIESIN - Columbia University. 2016. High Resolution Settlement Layer (HRSL). Source imagery for HRSL © 2016 DigitalGlobe. Accessed DAY MONTH YEAR.' Please note that as of 2024, Meta's high resolution population density maps are no longer being updated.

contact_point.name: AI and Data for Good at Meta

creator.name: AI and Data for Good at Meta

lineage.description: Machine learning algorithms identified building footprints from commercial satellite imagery across Samoa. Population estimates derived from publicly available census data and demographic statistics were spatially allocated to building locations using methodology developed with Columbia University partners, producing high-resolution gridded population density maps for overall population and seven demographic subgroups at the national scale.

sources.name: Facebook (satellite imagery and machine learning)
sources.description: Commercially available satellite imagery processed with machine learning to identify building footprints and locations across Samoa

sources.name: Columbia University
sources.description: Population estimation methodology overlaying census data and publicly available demographic statistics onto identified building locations to generate high-resolution population density maps
